people.name: Judea

translations.web: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
translations.bsb: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
translations.kjv: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
translations.asv: And after these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judaea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
